subject: integration
name: Web page reading standard (WEB_FETCH_0_1)
summary: The row for the WEB_FETCH_0_1 standard, which defines reading a public web page as text, from an address the person was asked about. A standard defines a code without answering it: the row runs nothing, holds no state and makes no connection. The browser answers this code itself and no integration provides it, so no other row judges the reading; the code marks every answer untrusted, since whoever controls a page may have written it for the reader. Open source, and the definition is a JSON file in Orivon's source. Judged here by its publisher.
